examples.hanzi: 这座大桥横跨在长江上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo héngkuà zài Chángjiāng shàng.
examples.english: This big bridge spans the Yangtze River.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司有很多跨国客户。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǒu hěn duō kuàguó kèhù.
examples.english: This company has many multinational clients.

examples.hanzi: 夏天她喜欢穿连衣裙。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān tā xǐhuan chuān liányīqún.
examples.english: In summer she likes to wear dresses.

examples.hanzi: 这条裙子的颜色很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi de yánsè hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The color of this skirt is very pretty.

examples.hanzi: 我们明天去博物馆参观。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān qù bówùguǎn cānguān.
examples.english: Tomorrow we are going to visit the museum.

examples.hanzi: 楼下新开了一家小餐馆。
examples.pinyin: Lóuxià xīn kāi le yì jiā xiǎo cānguǎn.
examples.english: A small restaurant has newly opened downstairs.

examples.hanzi: 狼在山上嗷嗷地叫。
examples.pinyin: Láng zài shān shàng áo'áo de jiào.
examples.english: The wolf is howling on the mountain.

examples.hanzi: 孩子嗷的一声哭了起来。
examples.pinyin: Háizi áo de yì shēng kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: The child burst into a wail.

examples.hanzi: 他的祖父是华裔，住在美国。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zǔfù shì huáyì, zhù zài Měiguó.
examples.english: His grandfather is of Chinese descent and lives in America.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家是一位韩裔美国人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā shì yí wèi Hányì Měiguórén.
examples.english: This writer is a Korean American.

examples.hanzi: 这个县城离省会不远。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiànchéng lí shěnghuì bù yuǎn.
examples.english: This county town is not far from the provincial capital.

examples.hanzi: 他是县里的老师。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì xiàn lǐ de lǎoshī.
examples.english: He is a teacher in the county.

examples.hanzi: 你坐哪个航班回去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò nǎge hángbān huíqù?
examples.english: Which flight are you taking back?

examples.hanzi: 轮船正在海上航行。
examples.pinyin: Lúnchuán zhèngzài hǎishàng hángxíng.
examples.english: The ship is sailing at sea.

examples.hanzi: 她对这个消息有点怀疑。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiāoxi yǒudiǎn huáiyí.
examples.english: She is a bit doubtful about this news.

examples.hanzi: 这个问题没有疑问。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí méiyǒu yíwèn.
examples.english: There is no doubt about this question.

examples.hanzi: 桑树的叶子很大。
examples.pinyin: Sāngshù de yèzi hěn dà.
examples.english: The leaves of the mulberry tree are big.

examples.hanzi: 她家有一片桑园。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā yǒu yí piàn sāngyuán.
examples.english: Her family has a mulberry orchard.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷年纪大了，身体有些衰弱。
examples.pinyin: Yéye niánjì dà le, shēntǐ yǒuxiē shuāiruò.
examples.english: Grandpa is getting old and his health is a little weak.

examples.hanzi: 这个国家的经济正在衰退。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jīngjì zhèngzài shuāituì.
examples.english: This country's economy is in decline.

examples.hanzi: 工人们辛勤劳动了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen xīnqín láodòng le yì zhěng tiān.
examples.english: The workers labored hard all day.

examples.hanzi: 谢谢你的帮忙，辛劳你了。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de bāngmáng, xīnláo nǐ le.
examples.english: Thanks for your help, I appreciate the effort.

examples.hanzi: 这个手机很智能。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī hěn zhìnéng.
examples.english: This phone is very smart.

examples.hanzi: 你的聪明才智让我佩服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cōngmíng cáizhì ràng wǒ pèifú.
examples.english: I admire your intelligence and talent.

examples.hanzi: 他终于还清了所有的债务。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú huán qīng le suǒyǒu de zhàiwù.
examples.english: He finally paid off all his debts.

examples.hanzi: 欠债还钱是应该的。
examples.pinyin: Qiàn zhài huán qián shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: Paying back what you owe is only right.

examples.hanzi: 参加考试的人必须带身份证。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā kǎoshì de rén bìxū dài shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: Those taking the exam must bring ID.

examples.hanzi: 你无须担心，一切都准备好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wúxū dānxīn, yíqiè dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: You need not worry, everything is ready.

examples.hanzi: 他年纪不大，却很懂事。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánjì bú dà, què hěn dǒngshì.
examples.english: He is not old, but he is very sensible.

examples.hanzi: 学生们要遵守课堂纪律。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen yào zūnshǒu kètáng jìlǜ.
examples.english: Students must follow classroom discipline.

examples.hanzi: 新年的时候，我们放鞭炮。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián de shíhou, wǒmen fàng biānpào.
examples.english: At the New Year we set off firecrackers.

examples.hanzi: 战士们守在大炮旁边。
examples.pinyin: Zhànshìmen shǒu zài dàpào pángbiān.
examples.english: The soldiers are standing guard by the cannon.

examples.hanzi: 他点了一份红烧鲍鱼。
examples.pinyin: Tā diǎn le yí fèn hóngshāo bàoyú.
examples.english: He ordered a portion of braised abalone.

examples.hanzi: 这位是鲍先生，我们的新同事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shì Bào xiānsheng, wǒmen de xīn tóngshì.
examples.english: This is Mr. Bao, our new colleague.

examples.hanzi: 他拿起锯子，开始锯木板。
examples.pinyin: Tā ná qǐ jùzi, kāishǐ jù mùbǎn.
examples.english: He picked up the saw and started sawing the board.

examples.hanzi: 这把锯很锋利，要小心使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ jù hěn fēnglì, yào xiǎoxīn shǐyòng.
examples.english: This saw is sharp, so use it carefully.

examples.hanzi: 他玩游戏玩上瘾了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wán yóuxì wán shàng yǐn le.
examples.english: He has become addicted to playing games.

examples.hanzi: 我今天过足了看电影的瘾。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān guò zú le kàn diànyǐng de yǐn.
examples.english: I got my fill of watching movies today.

examples.hanzi: 警察帮他把孩子赎了回来。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá bāng tā bǎ háizi shú le huílái.
examples.english: The police helped him get his child back from the kidnappers.

examples.hanzi: 他想赎罪，所以去做了志愿者。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng shúzuì, suǒyǐ qù zuò le zhìyuànzhě.
examples.english: He wants to atone for his wrongs, so he became a volunteer.

examples.hanzi: 他想了一番，还是决定去。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng le yì fān, háishi juédìng qù.
examples.english: He thought it over and still decided to go.

examples.hanzi: 我们把房间重新整理了一番。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ fángjiān chóngxīn zhěnglǐ le yì fān.
examples.english: We tidied up the room once more.

examples.hanzi: 盘子里有几粒花生米。
examples.pinyin: Pánzi lǐ yǒu jǐ lì huāshēngmǐ.
examples.english: There are a few peanuts on the plate.

examples.hanzi: 沙粒进了我的鞋子。
examples.pinyin: Shālì jìn le wǒ de xiézi.
examples.english: Sand grains got into my shoes.

examples.hanzi: 你把雨伞放进伞筒里吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ yǔsǎn fàng jìn sǎntǒng lǐ ba.
examples.english: Put your umbrella in the umbrella stand.

examples.hanzi: 请给我一支笔筒里的笔。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhī bǐtǒng lǐ de bǐ.
examples.english: Please give me a pen from the pen holder.

examples.hanzi: 你今天有空闲时间吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yǒu kòngxián shíjiān ma?
examples.english: Do you have any free time today?

examples.hanzi: 他退休后，每天都很清闲。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu, měitiān dōu hěn qīngxián.
examples.english: After retiring, he is at leisure every day.

examples.hanzi: 她喜欢在森林里采蘑菇。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zài sēnlín lǐ cǎi mógu.
examples.english: She likes picking mushrooms in the forest.

examples.hanzi: 记者今天去采访了一位老教授。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě jīntiān qù cǎifǎng le yí wèi lǎo jiàoshòu.
examples.english: The reporter went to interview an old professor today.

examples.hanzi: 你说的话是真实的吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de huà shì zhēnshí de ma?
examples.english: Are the things you said true?

examples.hanzi: 我们要把计划变成现实。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ jìhuà biànchéng xiànshí.
examples.english: We want to turn the plan into reality.

examples.hanzi: 北京的冬天很冷。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng de dōngtiān hěn lěng.
examples.english: Winter in Beijing is very cold.

examples.hanzi: 我明年想去南京看看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngnián xiǎng qù Nánjīng kànkan.
examples.english: Next year I want to go to Nanjing.

examples.hanzi: 两个国家打了好几年仗。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge guójiā dǎ le hǎojǐ nián zhàng.
examples.english: The two countries fought a war for several years.

examples.hanzi: 他倚仗父亲的关系找到了工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐzhàng fùqin de guānxi zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.english: He relied on his father's connections to find a job.

examples.hanzi: 冬天我穿厚厚的袜子。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ chuān hòuhòu de wàzi.
examples.english: In winter I wear thick socks.

examples.hanzi: 这双丝袜很容易破。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng sīwà hěn róngyì pò.
examples.english: These stockings tear easily.

examples.hanzi: 鱼被钩子钩住了。
examples.pinyin: Yú bèi gōuzi gōu zhù le.
examples.english: The fish was caught on the hook.

examples.hanzi: 他在答案旁边画了一个钩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dá'àn pángbiān huà le yí ge gōu.
examples.english: He drew a check mark next to the answer.

examples.hanzi: 他甚至连饭都忘了吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā shènzhì lián fàn dōu wàng le chī.
examples.english: He even forgot to eat.

examples.hanzi: 这件事我了解得不甚清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ liǎojiě de bú shèn qīngchu.
examples.english: I do not understand this matter very clearly.

examples.hanzi: 她为孩子的学习发愁。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi háizi de xuéxí fāchóu.
examples.english: She worries about her child's studies.

examples.hanzi: 你别愁眉苦脸的，事情会好的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié chóuméi kǔliǎn de, shìqing huì hǎo de.
examples.english: Don't look so troubled, things will get better.

examples.hanzi: 他不小心把膝盖磕破了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ xīgài kē pò le.
examples.english: He accidentally scraped his knee.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶在磕瓜子。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zài kē guāzǐ.
examples.english: Grandma is cracking sunflower seeds.

examples.hanzi: 他每天早上剃胡子。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang tì húzi.
examples.english: He shaves every morning.

examples.hanzi: 理发师把他的头发剃短了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐfàshī bǎ tā de tóufa tì duǎn le.
examples.english: The barber shaved his hair short.

examples.hanzi: 他憋着一口气潜入水里。
examples.pinyin: Tā biē zhe yì kǒu qì qiánrù shuǐ lǐ.
examples.english: He held his breath and dived into the water.

examples.hanzi: 有话就说，别憋在心里。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu huà jiù shuō, bié biē zài xīnlǐ.
examples.english: If you have something to say, say it, and don't hold it in.

examples.hanzi: 墙上刷了一层白漆。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shàng shuā le yì céng báiqī.
examples.english: The wall has been painted with a coat of white paint.

examples.hanzi: 屋里一片漆黑，什么都看不见。
examples.pinyin: Wū lǐ yí piàn qīhēi, shénme dōu kàn bu jiàn.
examples.english: It is pitch black inside, and nothing can be seen.

examples.hanzi: 欢迎大家来到我们学校。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng dàjiā láidào wǒmen xuéxiào.
examples.english: Welcome everyone to our school.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们看到礼物都很欢喜。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen kàndào lǐwù dōu hěn huānxǐ.
examples.english: The children were all delighted to see the gifts.

examples.hanzi: 这件事我们已经处理妥当了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen yǐjīng chǔlǐ tuǒdàng le.
examples.english: We have already handled this matter properly.

examples.hanzi: 机票都订妥了，你放心吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīpiào dōu dìng tuǒ le, nǐ fàngxīn ba.
examples.english: The flight tickets are all booked, so don't worry.

examples.hanzi: 我爹每天早上去田里干活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ diē měitiān zǎoshang qù tián lǐ gànhuó.
examples.english: My dad goes to work in the fields every morning.

examples.hanzi: 孩子大声喊着爹，跑了过去。
examples.pinyin: Háizi dàshēng hǎn zhe diē, pǎo le guòqù.
examples.english: The child ran over, shouting "Dad".

examples.hanzi: 大雨过后，墙塌了。
examples.pinyin: Dàyǔ guòhòu, qiáng tā le.
examples.english: After the heavy rain, the wall collapsed.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的蛋糕塌下去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de dàngāo tā xiàqù le.
examples.english: The cake from this shop sank in the middle.

examples.hanzi: 你们预订了几个房间？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen yùdìng le jǐ ge fángjiān?
examples.english: How many rooms did you reserve?

examples.hanzi: 明天的天气预报说有大雨。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de tiānqì yùbào shuō yǒu dàyǔ.
examples.english: Tomorrow's weather forecast says there will be heavy rain.

examples.hanzi: 她每周去练两次瑜伽。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu qù liàn liǎng cì yújiā.
examples.english: She goes to practice yoga twice a week.

examples.hanzi: 这位老师教瑜伽教得特别好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī jiāo yújiā jiāo de tèbié hǎo.
examples.english: This teacher teaches yoga especially well.

examples.hanzi: 他在阳台上种植了很多花。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yángtái shàng zhòngzhí le hěn duō huā.
examples.english: He grows a lot of flowers on the balcony.

examples.hanzi: 植物需要阳光和水。
examples.pinyin: Zhíwù xūyào yángguāng hé shuǐ.
examples.english: Plants need sunlight and water.

examples.hanzi: 他手上有一个旧伤疤。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng yǒu yí ge jiù shāngbā.
examples.english: He has an old scar on his hand.

examples.hanzi: 伤口好了以后会留下疤。
examples.pinyin: Shāngkǒu hǎo le yǐhòu huì liú xià bā.
examples.english: After the wound heals, a scar will remain.

examples.hanzi: 马路上有一条横线。
examples.pinyin: Mǎlù shàng yǒu yì tiáo héngxiàn.
examples.english: There is a horizontal line on the road.

examples.hanzi: 他横穿马路，很危险。
examples.pinyin: Tā héngchuān mǎlù, hěn wēixiǎn.
examples.english: He crossed the road diagonally, which is dangerous.

examples.hanzi: 你别太懒，要多运动。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài lǎn, yào duō yùndòng.
examples.english: Don't be too lazy, and exercise more.

examples.hanzi: 周末我就想懒在床上。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ jiù xiǎng lǎn zài chuáng shàng.
examples.english: On weekends I just want to laze in bed.

examples.hanzi: 听到好消息，他很激动。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào hǎo xiāoxi, tā hěn jīdòng.
examples.english: Hearing the good news, he was very excited.

examples.hanzi: 比赛进行得很激烈。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jìnxíng de hěn jīliè.
examples.english: The match was very intense.

examples.hanzi: 电影里有很多妖怪。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ yǒu hěn duō yāoguài.
examples.english: There are a lot of monsters in the movie.

examples.hanzi: 她穿得太妖艳了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuān de tài yāoyàn le.
examples.english: She is dressed too flashily.

examples.hanzi: 他把柴火捆成一捆一捆的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cháihuo kǔn chéng yì kǔn yì kǔn de.
examples.english: He tied the firewood into bundles.

examples.hanzi: 请用绳子把箱子捆紧。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng yòng shéngzi bǎ xiāngzi kǔn jǐn.
examples.english: Please tie the box tightly with rope.

examples.hanzi: 她在一家媒体公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā méitǐ gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: She works at a media company.

examples.hanzi: 这条新闻已经被各大媒体报道了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīnwén yǐjīng bèi gè dà méitǐ bàodào le.
examples.english: This news has been reported by major media outlets.
